boundaries.base_network_typo: Pinned FFDLinkRank calls network.get_attrs('link', 'resource'), but the pinned BaseNetwork exposes get_link_attrs(...). A dedicated case preserves that AttributeError; intended FFD arithmetic is isolated with a narrow fake that supplies get_attrs.
boundaries.native_workers: Python exposes no worker parameter. Repeated mixed cases compare native caller widths 1/2/8 while preserving identical ranking order and score bits.
boundaries.numpy_reduction: Int-only rows use NumPy int64 modular reduction before conversion to binary64; mixed rows use binary64 reduction. Every successful score is compared by its big-endian IEEE-754 bits.
boundaries.resource_selection: The intended fake returns link-resource rows in already-resolved registry order. Native code resolves dynamic resource selection once during preparation and ranks by numeric IDs/direct slots in hot loops.

payload_encoding: canonical JSON; ranking entries are [u,v,big-endian IEEE-754 binary64 hex]
